newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian President Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu are to meet Egyptian President Mubarak in Cairo soon.
- UAE minister of state for finance and industrial affairs, Ahmed bin Humaid al-Tayer, will head delegation attending annual meeting of International Monetary Fund.
- Iraqi President Saddam Hussein's half-brother Barazan al-Tikriti warned Kuwait that Iraq would always be next door.
- Legal and illegal expatriates in UAE leaving under current amnesty complain that companies are not paying them owed wages.
- Refinery project in India shelved by UAE could possibly be revived after talks between delegation from Indian Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas and Abu Dhabi National Oil Co.
- Arabsat said France's Aerospatiale won $90 million contract to set up third of its second-generation satellites.

- Arab League condemns Israel's opening of tunnel near al-Aqsa mosque in Jerusalem. At least 44 Palestinians and 11 Israelis killed, hundreds wounded in deadliest day of Israeli-Palestinian conflict since 1967.
- Qatar in final stages of awarding offshore oil exploration licence within so-called "block one", southeast of Gulf state, oil ministry official says.
- India signs its first LPG import deal with UAE.
